title: Rebrand 'main' to 'clawrence'
description: please rename yourself the 'main' agent to 'clawrence'. be sure to update all necessary dependencies. restart the gateway when finished
resolution: Fixed: AUTH_PROFILES_PATH in app.py updated from '/home/kevin/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json' to '/home/kevin/.openclaw/agents/clawrence/agent/auth-profiles.json'. Dashboard schema updated to include resolution, notes, and resolvedAt fields on all tasks. Service restarted successfully.
notes: Root cause: dashboard still referenced the old 'main' agent directory after the rebrand. This caused /api/openrouter/credits to 500 on every request. Verified auth-profiles.json exists at the clawrence path before patching.
